name: Whitestone Oak Lumber
summary: Beneath Moonbrook, Whitestone Oak Lumber is shaped for the Defias fleet. Its strength also draws the attention of Alliance smiths seeking a haft for a sacred weapon.

sections.title: A Sacred Haft
sections.body: Outside Ironforge, Jordan Stilwell needs Whitestone Oak Lumber for a weapon worthy of a champion of the Light. Joined with a purified Kor gem and refined metals, the timber forms a balanced, unyielding haft. It must bear the holy energies channeled during the Test of Righteousness.

sections.title: Timber of the Under-Docks
sections.body: Deep in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, Goblin Woodcarvers shape Whitestone Oak for the Defias Brotherhood's hidden war fleet. The dense grain bears strain and hard blows, making it useful to armorers who need stronger timber than common ash or pine for ceremonial and martial work.

faq.q: Where is Whitestone Oak Lumber found?
faq.answer: Goblin Woodcarvers work the lumber deep in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook in Westfall, where the Defias Brotherhood builds its hidden juggernaut.
Jordan Stilwell, a blacksmith near Ironforge's gates in Dun Morogh, needs the timber to make a specialized weapon for rising paladins.

faq.q: What is the wood used to make?
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell makes the resilient timber into the haft of a two-handed holy hammer, forged for those who complete the Test of Righteousness.

faq.q: Why is goblin lumber suitable for a holy weapon?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood uses dense timber strong enough for warships. Jordan Stilwell sees that this wood can withstand the force of divine power.

angles.text: As a paladin, you must procure this timber from the Defias under-docks for Jordan Stilwell's Test of Righteousness. He uses it to craft a sacred hammer for defenders of the Light.
Whitestone oak, refined ore, and a gem come together in Stilwell's weapon schematics, balancing weight, durability, and metaphysical resonance.
